summary: Protected five-colour Scarecrow kindred: establish mana and cards, land Reaper King behind interaction, then turn each tribal body into a Vindicate.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Thirty-nine cards are artifacts, including the commander, the Scarecrow spine, protection Equipment, ramp, and draw engines.

tags.name: changelings
tags.reason: Ten changeling creatures are run specifically because they count as Scarecrows with no support.

tags.name: etb effects
tags.reason: The whole plan is Reaper King's enter trigger, doubled by Panharmonicon and replayed through Crystal Shard.

tags.name: scarecrows
tags.reason: Thirteen printed Scarecrows in the 99 plus ten changeling creatures make the commander's trigger the primary plan.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Pili-Pala with Grand Architect produces infinite mana, normally converted through Mirror Entity.

tags.name: creatures
tags.reason: The tribal bodies and changelings build a wide board for Reaper King and Mirror Entity.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Kindred Discovery, Jhoira, Mystic Forge, Vedalken Archmage, Padeem, Skullclamp, and Thought Monitor create a real card-flow core.

tags.name: mana rocks
tags.reason: Arcane Signet, Chromatic Lantern, Coalition Relic, and Fellwar Stone support the five-colour cost.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck deploys bodies, grinds permanents off the table, and wins in the mid to late game.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Twelve ramp cards support the first commander cast and later seven- or nine-mana recasts.

tags.name: shapeshifters
tags.reason: The changeling package is entirely Shapeshifter creatures.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Sculpting Steel and Phyrexian Metamorph copy the best artifact on the table.

tags.name: color hack
tags.reason: Painter's Servant, Scuttlemutt, and Grand Architect recolour creatures for the Pili-Pala engine.

tags.name: mana dorks
tags.reason: Oasis Gardener and Scuttlemutt tap for mana while remaining Scarecrow triggers.

tags.name: multicolor matters
tags.reason: Nothing rewards multicolour directly, but the commander's hybrid cost drops by five when all five colours are online.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Mirrorworks, Maskwood Nexus, and Irregular Cohort provide a small token package.

tags.name: toolbox
tags.reason: Inventors' Fair finds the artifact the board needs.

tags.name: -1/-1 counters
tags.reason: Grim Poppet and Wingrattle Scarecrow are incidental counter interactions, not a package.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Scarecrone and Graveshifter rebuy bodies; there is no reanimation plan.

tags.name: type hack
tags.reason: Maskwood Nexus is the only remaining type-changing card.
